bop_calculator.title: What one platform is worth to your lot.
bop_calculator.sub: Drag the sliders to your dealership. The model separates hard cash saved from margin gained — and shows why, at thin dealer margins, the profit percentage moves more than you'd expect.
bop_calculator.card2_hint: Toggle what you pay for today · monthly €
bop_calculator.res_per: per month  ·  hard cash, before growth
bop_calculator.prof_note: Because dealer margins are thin, the same euros land as a big percentage swing.
bop_calculator.foot_note: Hard benefit = replaced tool subscriptions + labour hours reclaimed (AI spec import, listing copy, translation, photo cleanup, publishing, lead replies, BTW prep) valued at your loaded rate + floorplan carrying cost avoided from faster turn, minus the € 349/mo BOP subscription. Growth = incremental units × gross-per-car (softer upside). Marketplace listing fees (Marktplaats, Mobile.de, AutoScout24) are not counted as savings — those channels continue regardless. Benchmarks: dealers average ~6.8 software integrations per sale and thin ~2–3% net margins, so a modest absolute saving is a large share of profit. All figures are estimates for planning — override every input with your own.

Founder.eyebrow: Founder · SAP Solution Architect · Digital Manufacturing
Founder.sub: Sunay S. is the founder of DES (Digital Enterprise Solutions) and an SAP Solution Architect with 20+ years turning factory floors into connected, data-driven systems. From SAP S/4HANA and MES shopfloor integration to IoT, RFID and AI data lakes, he architects the layer where enterprise software meets the machine — and builds the DES ecosystem in parallel.
Founder.des_lead: The structural ecosystem Sunay founded and leads end-to-end — bringing the manufacturing, SAP and digital-transformation expertise of two decades into one platform for enterprises modernising their operations.
Founder.venture_p: DES is a services-plus-product ecosystem that connects the factory floor to the enterprise: SAP S/4HANA logistics, Manufacturing Execution Systems (MES), IoT devices and data platforms, unified into a single digital thread. Built on 20+ years of hands-on implementation, DES helps manufacturers plan smarter, capture real-time production and quality data, and turn that data into intelligence — delivered as consulting, integration, and productised solutions, including the in-house DES BOP — Business Operations Platform now in development.
Founder.pillar1_p: Integrate SAP (PP, QM, MM, EWM) with MES, RFID, inspection and automation devices via web services, IDoc & RFC.
Founder.pillar2_p: Design S/4HANA-ready manufacturing processes on SAP best practices — from greenfield rollouts to migrations.
Founder.pillar3_p: Collect shopfloor data into data lakes and BI/AI platforms for real-time visibility and smarter decisions.
Founder.arch_lead: The signature architecture Sunay has designed and delivered repeatedly across glass, biotech and industrial-oil plants — a vertical digital thread from field devices to enterprise intelligence.
Founder.arch_cap: Level 0–4 stack · every arrow is an interface Sunay has personally designed and shipped in production
Founder.arch_aria: SAP to MES integration architecture diagram
Founder.exp_lead: The disciplines Sunay combines to architect and deliver digital manufacturing at enterprise scale — functional, technical and architectural.
Founder.exp1_p: Deep functional ownership of SAP production and logistics — design, customise, configure, test, close gaps and deliver best-practice solutions across the full supply-chain core.
Founder.exp2_p: End-to-end command of the SAP-PP domain — the master-data and planning engine of any plant.
Founder.exp3_p: Setup and execution of Manufacturing Execution Systems — SAP ME/MII concepts, real-time production tracking, automated confirmation, quality data capture and equipment integration.
Founder.exp4_p: Connecting factory automation and external devices to SAP environments using open, standards-based interfaces — the hardest and most valuable layer of digital manufacturing.
Founder.exp5_p: Preparing software infrastructure for digital transformation — streaming shopfloor data into big-data storage, AI data lakes and BI platforms for real-time manufacturing intelligence.
Founder.exp6_p: Two decades of hands-on development of custom enterprise applications — from Oracle Forms factories to ABAP extensions and web tooling — plus database design and optimisation.
Founder.del_lead: Certified in PMP and ITIL, Sunay has led full implementation lifecycles — blueprint, build, cutover, hypercare — and multi-plant rollouts, aligning senior executives, business stakeholders and technical teams around one plan.
Founder.pm1_p: Project design (blueprint), master-data preparation, technical shopfloor infrastructure, cutover planning and execution — proven across six major ERP implementations, Oracle → ECC → S/4HANA.
Founder.pm2_p: Workflow rollouts and template deployments across flat glass, automotive glass and glassware factories — harmonising processes while respecting each plant's constraints.
Founder.pm3_p: Consulting senior executives on IT-manufacturing strategy while working hands-on with operators, quality teams and automation engineers — fluent at every altitude.
Founder.pm4_p: Formal project-management and IT-service-management discipline: scope, risk, incident and change management built into every engagement.
Founder.pm5_p: Contributed S/4HANA greenfield rollout into a brand-new biotech facility — standing up logistics, quality and lab-system integration from zero.
Founder.pm6_p: Designs processes from the SAP best-practice perspective, identifies gaps honestly, and engineers clean workarounds only where the business truly demands them.
Founder.proj_lead: A map of production-shipped work — every project below went live in a real factory.
Founder.proj1_desc: Led S/4HANA logistics modules and external interfaces — MES, Lab System (LIMS), Data Lake — and contributed to the greenfield S/4 rollout of a new biotech facility across PP, QM, MM, EWM.
Founder.proj2_desc: Supported third-party custom MES and S/4HANA integrations across manufacturing components for an automotive-sector lubricants producer.
Founder.proj3_desc: Integrated national enterprise software with SAP, redesigned PP flows (MRP, master data) and prepared migration infrastructure for S/4HANA.
Founder.proj4_desc: Consulted the SAP-PP module; designed new manufacturing processes from the SAP best-practice perspective and aligned all manufacturing systems to S/4HANA.
Founder.proj5_desc: Led PP, MM, QM, PM implementation for the shopfloor; collected manufacturing data via MES and streamed it into an AI Data Lake.
Founder.proj6_desc: Replaced legacy MES with a modern platform, upgraded shopfloor automation infrastructure and piped factory data into business-intelligence storage.
Founder.proj7_desc: Real-time goods tracking across warehouse, shipping and manufacturing — built new functionality between external RFID systems and SAP PP-WM.
Founder.proj8_desc: Collected all factory process-inspection values into SAP-QM: new inspection input screens plus automated capture from external automation systems.
Founder.proj9_desc: Full-cycle SAP-PP implementation for an automotive glass supplier: blueprint, shopfloor automation integration, client connection and labeling.

Founder.journey_lead: Two decades of enterprise software — developing and deploying since 2004, across glass, biotech and industrial-oil manufacturing.
Founder.tl1_p: Building the DES ecosystem and the BOP platform in parallel with part-time senior SAP support — bringing 20+ years of manufacturing expertise into one product-and-services platform.
Founder.tl2_p: Supported third-party custom MES and S/4HANA integrations across manufacturing components.

Founder.vision_lead: Sunay is a builder at heart — the consulting record funds and informs a bigger ambition: shipping his own software.
Founder.v1_p: Sunay is eager to develop software systems of his own — above all the BOP platform: a productised business-operations layer distilled from 20 years of factory integrations. The goal — give mid-size manufacturers the connected planning, execution and intelligence stack that today only enterprises can afford, without the enterprise price tag.
Founder.v2_p: A lifelong fascination with cars and vehicles runs through his career — from SAP implementations for automotive-glass suppliers to inspection-data integration on automotive lines. Sunay actively explores vehicle software, connected-car systems and the manufacturing technology behind how vehicles are built.
Founder.contact_p: Sunay is open to consulting, partnerships and collaboration around SAP, digital manufacturing and DES. Whether you're modernising a factory or scaling an idea — reach out.
